L4_CanRead.description: Read access to memory frame, or authority to send request through Endpoint capability.

L4_CanWrite.description: Write access to memory frame, authority to receive IPC requests, or retype untyped memory.

L4_CanGrant.description: Authority to delegate / transfer capabilities across IPC endpoints to another Conclave.

L4_CanGrantReply.description: Authority to pass single-use reply endpoint capabilities during synchronous IPC.

L4_CanBadge.description: Authority to mint an endpoint with an unforgeable hardware badge (L4_Cap_Mint_Ep).

L4_CanControl.description: Thread lifecycle management authority (suspend, resume, set stack pointer, set entrypoint).

L4_CanSync.description: Thread synchronization authority: read thread PC/SP/CPSR state without mutating registers.

format.bits_0_15: slot.client_id (16-bit Conclave Client Identifier assigned by Conclave Launcher)
format.bits_16_31: domain_id (16-bit Security Isolation Domain / Enclave Tag)
format.bits_32_63: session_nonce (32-bit ephemeral connection nonce or signal mask)

integrity_invariants: Badges are injected exclusively by the cL4 microkernel during L4_Cap_Mint_Ep.
Client conclave cannot modify badge bits on minted endpoint capability.
Upon message arrival, microkernel overwrites register x2 with unforgeable badge value.
Receiver compares badge with internal client session table to verify caller identity without cryptographic handshakes.

lifecycle_rules.attenuation_only: Derived capabilities must possess subset of parent rights. Bitwise: (child_rights & ~parent_rights) == 0.
lifecycle_rules.tree_derivation: Microkernel tracks capability lineage in derivation tree. Revocation of parent recursively deletes all descendants.
lifecycle_rules.memory_retyping: Untyped memory can only be retyped if all previously allocated objects from that range have been revoked and freed.
